assumptions: The 'last week of October' was taken as 25-31 October 2026 (the last 7 days of the month).
Settlement was measured as gross settled amount (before refunds and fees).
Scope is the NovaMart merchant group (all its merchants).
caveats: Attempt volume was 39% above the usual level for those weekdays over the 7 days. Sales and data gaps both look like this, so check before comparing totals across this period. It is not a data error by itself and was flagged for context only.
The settled figure reflects data up to the 31 October cut-off. Anything settling after that, including T+1 settlement of 31 October transactions, is not included.

facts.text: NovaMart transaction GMV for 25-31 October 2026 was ₹436,684,668.47 (about ₹43.67 crore).
Gross settled amount for the same period was ₹366,716,092.10 (about ₹36.67 crore).
GMV on 31 October settles T+1, after the data cut-off, so ₹69,968,576.37 (about ₹7.00 crore) was not yet settled. This is the largest component of the gap.
Refunds of ₹4,086,230.59 and fees (MDR) of ₹5,048,761.76 were netted off, taking settled net to ₹357,581,099.75.
Three NovaMart batches (Electronics, Fashion, Grocery) covering 25-26 October settled together on 28 October. They sit fully inside the window, so they have no net effect on the total.
The unexplained residual is ₹0.00 (0.0%), and no batches were flagged.
Attempt volume in the period was 39% above the usual level for those weekdays.

response.headline: For 25-31 October 2026, NovaMart's transaction GMV was ₹43.67 crore against ₹36.67 crore settled gross. The ₹6.99 crore gap is fully explained, mainly by 31 October volume that settles after the data cut-off.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Check NovaMart's campaign calendar for 25-31 October and compare daily attempt counts against ingestion logs for gaps.
hypotheses.rationale: Higher-than-usual volume is consistent with a sale, but the evidence cannot separate a real business event from a data gap.
hypotheses.text: The 39% volume spike is likely driven by a NovaMart sale or promotion, which also raised the 31 October amount awaiting settlement.

recommendations.linked_fact_or_hypothesis: GMV on 31 October settles T+1, after the data cut-off, so ₹69,968,576.37 (about ₹7.00 crore) was not yet settled.
recommendations.rationale: The gap is explained by settlement timing, so settled gross should move close to GMV less refunds once the batch arrives.
recommendations.text: Re-run this reconciliation once the 31 October T+1 settlement lands, to confirm the ₹7.00 crore timing gap closes.
